Your Link Name Share this page on your favorite Social network Facebook Twitter Reddit Close Popular Links Voting / Election Elected Officials Permits / Applications Police Department Highway Department RAVE & Smart 911 Resources Animal Control Contact Us Cultural Council Business Guide Procurement Contact Us Town of Swansea 81 Main Street Swansea, MA 02777 P: (508) 678-2981 F: (508) 324-6700 About Us Swansea is a rural/suburban community along the coast of Southeastern Massachusetts. Working farms still adorn main and secondary roadways alike, harkening back to this community's agrarian roots. The Town has a steep history in colonial America, being established in 1667 and incorporated in 1785. The community boasts commercial centers while also provide a plethora of recreational spaces for all abilities.
